summary: Ansible doesn't support interactive MFA, 2FA, biometrics or OTP prompts because they don't scale across many hosts; secure around Ansible with an automation user and use AWX or Automation Platform RBAC and credentials.
questions: Can Ansible handle an MFA prompt on every SSH login?
How should I use Ansible where hosts require 2FA?

answer_card.title: Ansible and MFA/2FA
answer_card.answer_md: No. Per-host interactive prompts (MFA, OTP, biometrics) don't scale. Use a dedicated **automation user** exempt from those prompts and secure access around Ansible, e.g. with **AWX/Automation Platform** RBAC, credential management and controlled job execution.
